questions: How many CuMnAs/AlAs/Al bars did you fabricate and measure, over how many cooldowns, and how many showed a zero-field diode and the remanent reversal of Fig. 3d?
Why were the others set aside?

Which ranges did you measure beyond the ones shown: temperatures above 20 mK, current ramps other than the 0.2 s step delay, and diode preparation fields along [100] beyond ±1 T (your Fig. 4c goes to ±5 T)?
What does the second-best device or dataset look like, for example the zero-field-cooled switching distributions of the [100] bar, or Fig. 3d repeated in a second cooldown?
What is the field at the sample at nominal H = 0 after each excursion, for each magnet axis, and how does η respond to a small applied field (a few mT, in plane and out of plane) swept through zero?

Did you warm above the 350 mK transition at H = 0 between preparation and readout, and does the diode polarity survive that? Relatedly, what sets the drop from about 27 and 31 µA after zero-field cooling (Fig. 3a inset) to about 17 to 21 µA after the ±1 T preparations (Fig. 3b)?

Your η reverses within about 0.1 T of preparation field (Fig. 3d), while Reven reverses near ±1.3 T (Fig. 4c), measured at 5 K on a bar from a different wafer. Could you comment on the different field scales, and on Extended Data Fig. 4a, where η after +1 T sits near −4%?
Were the [010] and [100] bars on the same chip and mounting, so that [100] lies along the same magnet coil for both, and have you repeated Fig. 3d with the chip rotated relative to the magnet axes?
